verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise pria sa(n)gam sujas naikaa bakhaanai sun sun sajanee sagal bigasaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife describes her union with her husband to her friends who feel pleased hearing the details;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੁਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: simar simar pria prem ras bisam hui sobhaa dhet mon gahe man musakaat hai ||

en.bdb: She fantasizes her union and goes into a state of ecstasy thinking about it. She expresses the beauty of the moment in her silence;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਰੁਦਨ ਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਮੁਦਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran adhaan prasoot samai rudhan sai gur jan mudhit hui taahee lapaTaat hai ||

en.bdb: On completion of her pregnancy and at the time of giving birth to the child, she cries in labour pain and her whimper pleases the elderly ladies of the house who express their love for her;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜਾਸੁ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਮੋਨਿ ਸਬਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurmukh prem bhagat pragaas jaas bolat bairaag mon sabahu suhaat hai ||414||

en.bdb: Similarly, a devoted Guru-conscious slave, whose heart is kindled with the Lord's love by virtue of meditation and contemplation, speaks in a state of renunciation from the world. (414)
